description: This file defines the AnnotationState class, a state management class in Flutter that caches annotation objects in memory, provides methods to load, add, update, delete, and clear annotations tied to chapter identifiers. It delegates persistence to an external AnnotationService and notifies listeners on state changes.

classes.name: AnnotationState
classes.description: Provides an in-memory cache for annotation objects, along with methods to load, add, update, delete, and clear annotations by chapter. Implements ChangeNotifier to facilitate state updates in Flutter widgets.

methods.name: AnnotationState
methods.description: Constructor which initializes the state, defaulting the annotation service to a singleton if none is provided.

methods.name: loadByChapter
methods.description: Asynchronously loads annotations for a specific chapter from the service into the cache, managing loading state and error handling.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new annotation via the service, updates cache, and sorts annotations by start offset and creation time.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing annotation via the service, refreshes the cache, and maintains sorted order.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an annotation by ID both in the service and cache, returning success status.

methods.name: clearForChapter
methods.description: Removes all annotations for a given chapter from the cache and persistent storage.

methods.name: getForChapter
methods.description: Returns cached annotations for a specified chapter or an empty list if none are loaded.
